subject: POC readiness: action cadence & network handoff for MedTide evaluation
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@medtide.health>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: ravi.patel@medtide.health
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC: MAP & network requirements (MedTide)

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and cost controls. As we talked, procurement needs a clear mutual action plan (MAP) so we can commit to a pilot this quarter. Can you send a proposed MAP focused specifically on environment readiness? Key items procurement/security asked for:

- Org invite & role mapping for our SREs and app team
- API key pattern and expiry / rotation guidance
- IP allowlist (we can provide CIDRs) and expected NAT egress behavior
- VPC peering steps and typical turnaround time (GCP for us)

I attached the internal template our PM uses — feel free to slot in dates. We are targeting a 4-week evaluation window starting June 1.

Claire
Director of Engineering
MedTide Health

Attachments: MedTide_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet template)

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@medtide.health>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@medtide.health>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: MAP & network requirements (MedTide)

Claire — great to hear. I sketched a compact MAP below that aligns with your June 1 start. I put tentative owners and target dates; please flag anything that won't work.

High level MAP (4-week evaluation)
- Week 0 (May 20–24): Contracts + SOW signoff (sales/procurement) — owner: myself — target: May 24
- Week 1 (May 27–31): Environment prep — owners: Marissa (networks), Karthik (org/API) — tasks: org invite, API key provisioning, IP allowlist applied, VPC peering request submitted
- Week 2 (Jun 3–7): Baseline tests & sample runs — owners: MedTide devs + Redwood SRE (hannah) — tasks: smoke tests, latency/throughput baseline, KV cache check
- Week 3 (Jun 10–14): Workload validation & eval metrics collection — owners: joint
- Week 4 (Jun 17–21): Final review & close decision — owner: Claire/Ravi

Immediate asks from our side so we can hit Week 1:
1) Please share the CIDR blocks (or static egress IPs) you want on the allowlist. For GCP we usually peer using VPC peering or Private Service Connect — which is your preference?
2) Provide the account email(s) for org invite and indicate the role (owner/admin/dev). We will create a scoped service account for API usage and will not expose root keys.
3) Any required SOC2 or security form fields we should prioritize in the MAP?

I'll loop Marissa and Karthik to confirm peering timeline and API key mechanics. Hannah — can you own the test plan for Week 2?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s) referenced: MedTide_MAP_v2.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: MAP & network requirements (MedTide)

Looping in for network details. Quick notes on our side based on typical GCP setups:

- VPC peering: from Redwood side we can accept a request and provision the peering within 1–3 business days once we have your VPC project ID and subnet ranges. Typical blockers: overlapping CIDRs (need non-overlap) and security policy approvals from your infra team.
- IP allowlist: we can accept either a set of static egress IPs (preferred) or named CIDR ranges. If you need outbound NAT behavior documented, we can provide a short runbook.
- Ports/Protocols: our agent needs outbound 443 and 80 to our control plane (if using Redwood Private control plane for your tenancy), and internal peered traffic over 50051 (gRPC) for the runtime connection.
- Peering vs PSC: if you require Private Service Connect (PSC) instead of VPC peering, lead time is usually 5–7 business days because of entitlement checks.

Action items for Week 1 (network):
- MedTide: share project ID, VPC name, non-overlapping subnets, and preferred peering approach (peering vs PSC) — owner: Claire/Ravi — due: May 24
- Redwood: open peering ticket and share connection validation checklist — owner: Marissa — target: May 25

I will prepare the network diagram (PDF) and a short checklist to attach to the MAP.

-Marissa
Senior Cloud Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s) created: network-diagram-medtide.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@medtide.health>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@medtide.health>, logan_wright@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: MAP & network requirements (MedTide)

Claire/Ravi — following up with the network checklist and a couple of clarifications so we can lock Week 1: 

Checklist (what we need from MedTide)
- GCP project ID and VPC name
- Non-overlapping IPv4 CIDR(s) to peer (e.g., 10.40.0.0/16)
- Firewall rules you are willing to add for inbound from Redwood (suggested: allow TCP 50051 from our peered subnets)
- Static egress IPs if you want us to allow specific outbound ranges or we can provide our outbound IP set
- Point of contact for peering ticket (name + email + preferred SLACK channel)

On API keys/org setup (cc: Karthik) — our recommended pattern:
- Redwood will create a scoped service account per environment (staging/poc) and issue a time-bound API key (90 days default).
- Keys can be rotated by calling the Admin API or via the Console; we will document the rotation REST call in the MAP.
- For SSO/org invites: invite these emails as Organization Editors: dev-team@medtide.health, ops-team@medtide.health. If you prefer role separation we can make ops-team an Org Viewer.

If you confirm the peering approach (VPC peering preferred for speed), we can file the ticket today and aim for a May 25 provisioning. Otherwise, if you need PSC, let us know and we will shift the target to May 31.

Next steps / immediate asks:
- Claire: confirm VPC peering (yes/no) and share the project ID + POC email by EOD May 19.
- Logan: I'll draft the MAP with dates and upload the two attachments to the Drive link; I'll also include the API key rotation snippet.

-Marissa

Attachment(s): network-diagram-medtide.pdf

We will add dev-team@medtide.health and ops-team@medtide.health to the invite list. We will also accept a 90-day API key window. Please file the peering ticket and share the Drive MAP with the dates so procurement can review.

Claire
